product_one_liner.value: CloudTalk combines business calling, AI-powered conversation intelligence, and autonomous voice agents for small and mid-sized sales and customer-support teams.

eng_blog.notes: Includes integration-implementation and testing-strategy posts by Josef Lapka, whose profile identifies him as CPTO; the articles' author bios inconsistently label him 'Senior Copywriter'.
